about_the_game:
Ever pulled an all-nighter?

Know that feeling when you're physically exhausted but mentally wide awake, staring at the ceiling?

Ever find yourself replaying conversations you wish you'd handled differently, or reliving old memories that come rushing back in the quiet of the night?

Or maybe you've been there – knowing you have to wake up early, yet stuck in that cycle of anxiously watching the clock while scrolling endlessly on your phone.

If you've never experienced this, Sleep Well will immerse you in the reality of a long, restless night.

If this feels all too familiar, then Sleep Well is here to resonate deeply with you.

Game Introduction

Sleep Well is a word adventure game about soothing your thoughts and finding inner calm. You'll follow the story of Xiaoye, a girl plagued by insomnia. As night falls, her mind turns into a chaotic party, and her poor sleep habits only make it harder to find rest.

She needs someone to listen – and that's where you come in. You'll help her navigate the noisy voices in her mind, making choices to quiet the thoughts that keep her awake, and guide her out of the cycle of sleeplessness. Your goal: to help her finally sleep well.

A Lighthearted Slice-of-Life Story

Xiaoye has a habit of getting lost in conversations with herself – and now, you'll become the new voice in her head, the one that gently suggests, "Maybe it's time to sleep."

The stress and emotions from her part-time job often hit hard at night. She might crave a guilty midnight snack, or lie awake frustrated after a tough day at work. She needs an outlet for her stress, a way to calm her emotions – but her body also desperately needs rest. In these moments, it's like an angel and a devil are tugging at her shoulders – and your choices will be the key to breaking the stalemate.

As you spend sleepless nights with Xiaoye, you'll piece together fragments of her memories, slowly uncovering her past and personality, and eventually discover the real reason behind her insomnia.

Multiple Endings

Xiaoye's struggle with sleep has been going on for a long time. Where her nights lead depends entirely on your guidance. She might take too many sleeping pills, or collapse from exhaustion during a busy workday after consecutive sleepless nights... Will this dark-circled girl ever find peaceful rest? It's up to you to find out.

Finally...

Thank you for reading this far.

Whether you decide to purchase the game or not, we sincerely wish you one simple thing:

Have a Good Night~

  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
